title: City of El Cajon, California confirms network security incident; data reported on Rhysida leak site
date_note: NBC 7's report is dated 23 November and gives no earlier day for the data's appearance; the incident's own start date is not stated clearly enough to use.
geo_basis: victim city named in the reports
summary: NBC 7 San Diego reports that City Manager Graham Mitchell confirmed a network security incident at El Cajon, and that the city has brought in a third-party forensic firm. The report says a trove of nearly eight terabytes, including employee W-2s, emergency-call recordings and undercover police rosters, has appeared on a ransomware leak site. NBC 7 says watchdog groups attribute it to Rhysida; the city says it is fully operational.
plain: NBC 7 reports that the city of El Cajon confirmed a network security incident, and that city data, including police and emergency-call material, has appeared on a ransomware leak site.
exec: A city confirmed an incident; NBC 7 reports that records, including undercover police rosters, appeared on a leak site.

validation.note: NBC 7 San Diego is the original report; KOGO (iHeart) relays NBC 7, so they are one account. The city's own statement was not read; NBC 7 quotes the City Manager.

review.note: plain/exec said stolen; source says data appeared on a leak site (stronger than source). Rest matched NBC 7.
